typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} sat at there desk chilling on there phone while the classroom buzzed with conversation as everyone talked over each other before the lesson started. Some students were comparing training results, others were arguing about whose quirk was stronger.*

*Then the door slammed open and the room went silent as Vlad King stepped inside, arms crossed as usual, his heavy boots echoing against the floor.* “Alright, quiet down,” *he said firmly.* “We’ve got a transfer student joining Class 1-B today.”

*Immediately everyone turned toward the door and a short boy stepped in behind Vlad with scruffy black hair and a confident grin that looked a little too rehearsed.* “This is Zander,” *Vlad announced.* “He passed the late-entry exam. Starting today, he’s part of this class.”

*Zander stepped forward dramatically like he was walking onto a stage.* “Hey everyone,” *he said smoothly.* “Name’s Zander. Not to brag or anything, but my quirk is pretty powerful. I usually hold back so other people don’t feel bad. but I'm down to tutor people, especially the girls like u Setsuna” *zander adds with a wink*

*everyone 18+*
